{{nihongo|'''Enoki Shrine'''|榎神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Owari Province]].

'''Enoki Shrine''' (えのきじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} located in {{ill|Kawashima Matsukura-machi|ja|川島松倉町|qid=Q131870131}}, {{ill|Kakamigahara|Q641491|qid=Q641491}}, {{ill|Gifu Prefecture|Q131277|qid=Q131277}}.

It is one of the disputed sites of '''Kawashima Shrine''' of {{ill|Haguri District|Q1032507|qid=Q1032507}}, {{ill|Owari Province|Q514506|qid=Q514506}}, listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Engishiki}} {{sfn|Kawashima Town|1982|pp=1181–1182}}<ref>In the “Binō Haguri Kenbunshū,” compiled in the first year of {{ill|Kyōwa|Q960763|qid=Q960763}}, the Engishiki Kawashima Shrine is described as Enoki Myōjin of Ushigo Village.</ref>.

=== Overview ===
The date of establishment is unknown. The former name of this area was Nishiushigo in {{ill|Haguri District|Q1032507|qid=Q1032507}}, {{ill|Kōnuma-gō|ja|河沼郷|qid=Q11553979}}, {{ill|Owari Province|Q514506|qid=Q514506}}, and it is said to have been the central area of the islands (Kawashima) of the Kiso River in the vicinity {{sfn|Kawashima Town|1982|pp=1165–1166}}. During the Heian period, it is said to have been the tutelary shrine of a {{ill|Tiantai|Q668188|qid=Q668188}} temple (later Chōkō-ji)<ref>A temple located at 260 Kawashima Matsukura-chō, Kakamigahara City. It was formerly called Shirahige Daimyōjin, but because there was a large {{ill|Celtis sinensis|ar|ميس صيني|arz|ميس صينى|az|Çin dağdağanı|be|Celtis sinensis|ca|Celtis sinensis|ceb|Celtis sinensis|es|Celtis sinensis|id|Celtis sinensis|ja|エノキ|ko|팽나무|la|Celtis sinensis|ru|Каркас китайский|sv|Celtis sinensis|vi|Cơm nguội Trung Quốc|zh|朴樹|zh_yue|朴樹|qid=Q706339|lt=hackberry}} tree within the shrine grounds, it was renamed Enoki Myōjin during the {{ill|Genbun|Q1145754|qid=Q1145754}} era by the high-ranking hatamoto {{ill|Tsubouchi clan|ja|坪内氏|qid=Q11425737}} {{sfn|Kawashima Town|1982|pp=1165–1166}}{{sfn|Kawashima Town|1982|pp=1181–1182}}. During the {{ill|Kan'en|de|Kan’en|fa|کانئن|fr|Ère Kan'en|it|Kan'en|ja|寛延|ko|간엔|ru|Канъэн|simple|Kan'en|sr|Канен|sv|Kanen|tr|Kan'en|zh|寬延|qid=Q1145723}} era, it was relocated to what later became Kawashima Village, Ōaza Matsukura, Aza Nishiushigo 1979 {{sfn|Kawashima Town|1982|pp=1165–1166}}. In the flood disaster of {{ill|Meiji era|Q3125096|qid=Q3125096}} 1 ({{ill|1868|Q7717|qid=Q7717}}) {{ill|May 9 (Lunisolar)|cdo|5 nguŏk 9 hô̤ (nùng-lĭk)|ja|5月9日 (旧暦)|ko|음력 5월 9일|zh|五月初九|zh_min_nan|5 goe̍h 9 ji̍t (kū-le̍k)|zh_yue|五月初九|qid=Q839631|lt=May 9}} (present-day {{ill|June 28|Q2660|qid=Q2660}}), the shrine grounds became a riverbed <ref name="Gifu Disaster Records">{{Cite web|Japanese|url=http://yosikitigakubu.g3.xrea.com/saiisi4.html|title=Gifu Prefecture Disaster Records: Data from 1800–1899|publisher=Gifu Prefecture|language=Japanese|accessdate=2025-01-01}}</ref>, among other instances of flood damage.

Later, because the enshrined location would become the riverbed of a new {{ill|main stream|Q11356312|qid=Q11356312|lt=main stream}} due to Kiso River improvement works, the shrine was relocated to its current location on April 30, {{ill|1907|Q2048|qid=Q2048}} ({{ill|Meiji era|Q3125096|qid=Q3125096}} 40) {{sfn|Kawashima Town|1982|pp=1165–1166}}{{sfn|Kawashima Town|1982|pp=1181–1182}}.

It is adjacent to {{ill|Kasekiko Park|Q11554115|qid=Q11554115}}, and it is also possible to enter the shrine grounds from the park.

=== Enshrined deity ===
* {{ill|Sarutahiko Ōkami|Q3090037|qid=Q3090037|lt=Sarutahiko no Ōkami}}

=== Subsidiary shrines ===
* Shinmei Shrine
* Konpira Shrine

=== Other ===
* A wooden statue (seated figure) is enshrined in the shrine building. Although details of the statue are unknown, it bears the inscription “Kawashima-san” (the {{ill|sangō|Q11058522|qid=Q11058522|lt=mountain name}} of Chōkō-ji) {{sfn|Kawashima Town|1982|pp=1165–1166}}.
* The Gifu Prefecture Association of Shinto Shrines considers the founding to be during the Kan’en era <ref>[https://www.gifu-jinjacho.jp/syosai.php?shrno=146&shrname=%E2%98%85%E6%A6%8E%E7%A5%9E%E7%A4%BE%E2%98%85 Enoki Shrine (Gifu Prefecture Association of Shinto Shrines)]</ref>. This corresponds to the year the shrine was relocated.

=== Transportation ===
* Get off at “Matsukura Kōminkan-mae” bus stop on the {{ill|Kakamigahara City Fureai Bus|Q11412316|qid=Q11412316}} Kawashima Line; 7-minute walk.
* Get off at “Matsukura-guchi” bus stop on the {{ill|Meitetsu Bus|Q6810397|qid=Q6810397}}; 7-minute walk.
